Jharkhand CID arrests another suspect in exam irregularities case

Jharkhand's Criminal Investigation Department (CID) has arrested one more individual in connection with irregularities in the Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) Combined Graduate Level (CGL) examination. This arrest brings the total number of apprehensions by the agency to nine since August 18. The arrested individual is identified as Sameer Kumar, a successful candidate in the exam, apprehended from Giridih. The CID has been investigating allegations of a paper leak and other irregularities in the examination process.
